method.index_match: NFKC, lowercase, remove punctuation/spacing; title and explicit aliases only.
method.history_match: Exact normalized title or explicit ledger_id/candidate_id/ledger in source manifest. Titles inside source/evidence objects excluded.
method.path_match: Existing dictionary_paths from current ledger checked against current Git tree.
method.possible_spelling_variant: Remove parenthetical text or trailing 드립/밈/유행/문화; comparison hint only, not merged.
method.negative_meaning: unresolved_no_exact_evidence does not mean unreviewed, absent, invalid or eligible. Historical decisions can remain in unstructured notes, earlier threads, variants, or files outside these 65 manifests.
method.overlap: The triage bucket is exclusive and uses the listed first-match priority. Evidence arrays may overlap: a path-linked row may also have exact title and historical matches. Bucket counts, not evidence-array lengths, sum to 1091.

limits: Original ledger statuses were not changed; included paths are not a new quality audit.
Historical held records are not newly researched candidates and are not automatically current held decisions.
Manifest mention can be exclusion, reservation, scope review or draft; it does not imply publication.
Index title matching does not establish that an entire broad parent item has been covered.
This is a fixed snapshot. Pending wave18 and future changes require a refreshed comparison.
No original source articles were re-verified for this bookkeeping report. No new canonical files or usage profiles.
Ledger titles and source reason prose omitted from this derived report to avoid re-copying sensitive labels. Original IDs and fixed-ref links preserve traceability.
